description: This file defines FastAPI routes for telemetry-related API endpoints, including ingestion of telemetry data, retrieval of the last telemetry items, and listing available metrics. It includes route definitions, dependency injections, and response models.

methods.name: int ingest(req: TelemetryIngestRequest, svc=Depends(get_telemetry_service))
methods.description: Handles ingestion of telemetry items, accepting a TelemetryIngestRequest object and returning the count of ingested items.

methods.name: List[TelemetryItem] last(n: int = Query(1, description="Number of last items"), svc=Depends(get_telemetry_service))
methods.description: Retrieves the last N telemetry items, where N defaults to 1.

methods.name: List[str] metrics(svc=Depends(get_telemetry_service))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of metric names available in the telemetry buffer.

ctags.name: last
ctags.pattern: /^def last(n: int = Query(1, description="Number of last items"), svc=Depends(get_telemetry_servic/
ctags.signature: (n: int = Query(1, description="Number of last items"), svc=Depends(get_telemetry_service))
